action_input.sql:
SELECT
  c.Score
FROM 'csv/comments.csv' AS c
JOIN 'db/posts.db' AS p
  ON c.PostId = p.posts.Id
WHERE
  p.posts.ViewCount BETWEEN 100 AND 150
ORDER BY
  c.Score DESC
LIMIT 1;
